title: Builder Signals · 2026-07-26
summary: Follow Builders 今日捕捉到 48 条 X 动态、1 集播客、1 篇博客；本站精选 20 条高信号内容。

featured.title: Swyx · AI Engineer / Smol AI 创始人
featured.summaryEn: Swyx added four new features to SmolForge, explicitly including customizable skins and spritesheet animations. He also said that “extremely stupid defaults” in existing productivity software are why he is building a new G Suite—two examples of the same builder instinct: replace the product layer rather than tolerate its constraints.
featured.insightZh: Swyx 给 SmolForge 加了四项新功能，其中明确提到可定制皮肤和 spritesheet 动画；同时，他把自己开发“新一代 G Suite”的动机归因于现有办公软件里一些极其糟糕的默认设置。两条动态都指向同一个 builder 逻辑：与其忍受工具边界，不如直接重做产品层。

featured.title: Josh Woodward · Google Labs / Gemini 副总裁
featured.summaryEn: Josh Woodward demonstrated Gemini Spark’s shift from conversation to execution: upload a school-calendar PDF and ask Gemini to add every “No School” date to Google Calendar. The feature is now live for Google AI Pro subscribers in the US, with global expansion planned next.
featured.insightZh: Josh Woodward 用一个具体场景展示 Gemini Spark 的“从对话到执行”：上传学校日历 PDF，让 Gemini 把所有“No School”日期直接加入 Google Calendar。该能力已面向美国 Google AI Pro 订阅用户上线，下一步将扩展到全球。

featured.title: Building an Autonomous Delivery Experience with DoorDash Co-Founders Andy Fang and Stanley Tang
featured.summaryEn: DoorDash is rebuilding itself from a delivery marketplace into an agentic-commerce and multimodal autonomy network. Its moat is not any single robot, but ten billion historical deliveries, merchant integrations, dispatch infrastructure, and proprietary knowledge of the first and last 100 feet. Andy Fang and Stanley Tang said Ask DoorDash is already changing consumer behavior: about 50% of restaurant journeys lead users to merchants they have never ordered from, while grocery baskets are roughly 40% larger. Conversational intent makes complex needs—dietary constraints, family meals, restocking a refrigerator—easier to express, with the longer-term path pointing toward agents that purchase automatically from context. DoorDash began autonomy experiments in 2018 and concluded that both ends of the market were mismatched: two-to-three-mile-per-hour sidewalk robots cannot serve typical three-…
featured.insightZh: DoorDash 正把自己从外卖平台重构为 agentic commerce 与多模态自动配送网络，而真正的壁垒不是某一台机器人，而是 100 亿次历史配送数据、商户集成、调度系统以及“最后 100 英尺”的现实世界知识。 Andy Fang 和 Stanley Tang 介绍，Ask DoorDash 已经改变消费行为：餐厅场景中约 50% 的使用路径会导向用户从未下单过的商家，杂货场景的客单量则高出约 40%。对话界面让用户可以直接表达饮食偏好、家庭聚餐、补充冰箱等复杂意图，下一步则是让 agent 根据环境与上下文自动完成采购。 DoorDash 从 2018 年开始用小型实验探索自动化，最终发现两端方案都不适配：时速 2–3 英里的 sidewalk robot 无法覆盖平均 3–5 英里的配送，而 4,000 磅的 robotaxi 对几份餐食又严重过度设计。因此公司自研了约 300 磅、最高时速 20 英里、可在道路和自行车道运行的 Dot，并建立 autonomous delivery platform，把 Dasher、机器人、无人机和合作伙伴车辆按场景组合起来。 创始人并不认为自动化会简单消灭 900 万 Dashers。DoorDash 每年完成约 30 亿次配送、业务仍以约 25% 年增速扩张，未来更可能形成多模态运力：复杂订单继续由人完成，密集郊区交给 Dot，轻量偏远订单可用无人机。规模优势来自真实世界长尾——不同城市、天气、商户、商品和门牌入口都不同，而这些第一/最后 100 英尺数据不在地图里，只存在于 DoorDash 的历史网络中。

items.title: Boris Cherny · Anthropic Claude Code 负责人
items.summaryEn: Boris Cherny says the most important Opus 5 improvement is not only its coding, analytics, and knowledge-work performance, but that it is Anthropic’s least prompt-injectable model yet. In their testing, layering model alignment, prompt-injection probes, and Claude Code Auto Mode drove attack success to roughly zero—an argument for defense in depth rather than reliance on a single safeguard.
items.insightZh: Boris Cherny 认为 Opus 5 最值得关注的不只是编码、数据分析和知识工作能力，而是它成为 Anthropic 迄今最难被 prompt injection 攻破的模型。按他的说法，将模型对齐、注入探针与 Claude Code Auto Mode 叠加后，测试中的 prompt injection 成功率降至约零；这强调的是分层防御，而非依赖单一模型能力。

items.title: Thibault Sottiaux · OpenAI Codex / ChatGPT 产品
items.summaryEn: Thibault Sottiaux announced that ChatGPT Work is now available globally across all paid plans on mobile, web, and desktop, describing it as “a jetpack” for ChatGPT. The core signal is that OpenAI is moving work-oriented agent capabilities from limited rollout to broad, cross-device availability.
items.insightZh: Thibault Sottiaux 宣布 ChatGPT Work 已面向所有付费方案全球开放，覆盖移动端、Web 和桌面端，并形容它像是“给 ChatGPT 装上喷气背包”。核心信号是 OpenAI 正在把面向工作的 agent 能力从局部测试推向跨终端的普遍可用。

items.title: Peter Yang · AI 教程创作者
items.summaryEn: Peter Yang shared two practical observations: voice control over ChatGPT and Codex makes it possible to direct coding work hands-free, but only if you can remember the names of long-running threads. He also argued that pure software is becoming difficult for indie developers to monetize, often requiring an added layer such as services—highlighting both agent workflow friction and pressure on software business models.
items.insightZh: Peter Yang 分享了两点实际观察：语音连接 ChatGPT 与 Codex 后，可以躺着调度编码工作，但前提是记住各个长任务线程的名称；另一方面，独立开发者越来越难靠纯软件变现，产品往往需要叠加服务等额外价值。前者暴露了 agent 工作流的线程管理摩擦，后者则提示软件商业模式正在被 AI 压缩。

items.title: Madhu Guru · Meta AI 高级总监、前 Gemini / Veo / Nano Banana 负责人
items.summaryEn: Madhu Guru sees a major opportunity in adapting foundation models to messy real-world workflows. The scarce skill is not simply calling a model, but understanding how work gets done, designing evaluations, improving models through post-training, and building continuous feedback loops—the capabilities required to turn a general model into an exceptional domain specialist.
items.insightZh: Madhu Guru 判断，未来几年最大的机会之一，是把基础模型适配到混乱的真实业务流程。真正稀缺的能力不是简单调用模型，而是理解工作如何发生、设计 eval、通过 post-training 改进模型，并建立持续反馈闭环；这套能力目前仍集中在少数实验室，却是通用模型变成垂直领域专家的关键。

items.title: Thariq · Anthropic Claude Code 团队
items.summaryEn: Thariq said Anthropic removed roughly 80% of the Claude Code system prompt for its newest models and shared lessons for writing system prompts, skills, and Claude.md files. The product implication is direct: elaborate scaffolding built for older models may become counterproductive, with newer workflows favoring simpler instructions and task-based pairing between Opus 5 and Fable.
items.insightZh: Thariq 透露，Anthropic 为最新模型删掉了约 80% 的 Claude Code system prompt，并总结了如何为新模型编写 system prompts、skills 和 Claude.md。其产品含义很直接：模型能力跃迁可能让为旧模型堆叠的复杂指令失效，新的最佳实践更偏向精简提示，并按任务在 Opus 5 与 Fable 之间分工。

items.title: Amjad Masad · Replit CEO
items.summaryEn: Amjad Masad touched capital, product, and policy at once: he noted that VCs passed on Etched early before waking up to it, said returning Replit users would find a major surprise, and publicly challenged Anthropic to clarify whether it supports banning open-weight models. Together, the posts show simultaneous reassessment across AI infrastructure, application platforms, and model policy.
items.insightZh: Amjad Masad 同时关注资本、产品与政策：他回顾 Etched 早期曾被 VC 普遍错过，如今投资者终于转向；称久未使用 Replit 的用户会发现产品变化巨大；并公开追问 Anthropic 是否支持禁止 open-weight 模型。三条动态共同反映出 AI 基础设施、应用平台和开放模型政策正在同步重估。

items.title: Guillermo Rauch · Vercel CEO
items.summaryEn: Guillermo Rauch gave Figma2React a concise but explicit endorsement: “It’s good.” It is a lightweight but notable signal that design-to-React workflows are reaching a level of usability that a leading developer-platform founder is willing to endorse publicly.
items.insightZh: Guillermo Rauch 对 Figma2React 给出简短但明确的肯定：“It’s good.” 这是一条轻量信号，说明从设计稿直接生成 React 实现的工作流正在达到头部开发平台创始人愿意公开认可的可用水平。

items.title: Alex Albert · Anthropic 研究员
items.summaryEn: Alex Albert says that just over six months later, Opus 5 can produce near-superhuman spreadsheets and slide decks comparable to consultant work. He also highlighted its cross-domain token efficiency and smooth feel, saying he prefers Opus 5 over Fable 5 for many coding tasks.
items.insightZh: Alex Albert 称，六个多月后，Opus 5 已能生成接近“超人水平”的电子表格和媲美咨询顾问的演示文稿。他还强调该模型在跨领域提升智能水平的同时更节省 token，使用体验流畅，并表示在许多编码任务上自己更偏好 Opus 5 而非 Fable 5。

items.title: Aaron Levie · Box CEO
items.summaryEn: Aaron Levie shared the day’s most concrete enterprise evaluation data: on Box’s Complex Work Eval, Opus 5 improved over 4.8 by roughly 17% in due diligence, 30% in life sciences, 12% in legal, 19% in technology, and 13% in healthcare, especially on complete multi-step analysis over messy unstructured data. He also argued that open and closed models are not zero-sum: frontier models can handle high-end orchestration while open weights enable lower-cost, customizable vertical workloads and broader diffusion.
items.insightZh: Aaron Levie 给出了今天最具体的企业评测数据：Box Complex Work Eval 中，Opus 5 相比 4.8 在尽调、生命科学、法律、科技和医疗任务上分别取得约 +17%、+30%、+12%、+19% 和 +13% 的提升，改善集中在复杂非结构化材料上的完整、多步分析。同时他力挺 open weights，认为开放与闭源并非零和：前沿模型承担高端编排，开放模型则支持低成本、可定制的垂直工作负载，并加速 AI 在经济中的扩散。

items.title: Garry Tan · Y Combinator CEO
items.summaryEn: Garry Tan argues that macro productivity gains from AI will not arrive through tool adoption alone: managers and CEOs must authorize radically different staffing and workflow plans, and the organizational transition may take ten years rather than two. He also cited research suggesting that technology-adoption speed explains at least 25% of national wealth differences over the last 200 years, placing enterprise change in a longer diffusion cycle.
items.insightZh: Garry Tan 提醒，AI 带来的宏观生产率提升不会仅靠工具渗透自动发生，管理者和 CEO 必须批准完全不同的人员配置与工作流，而这轮组织重构可能需要十年而非两年。他同时引用历史研究称，过去 200 年各国采用新技术的速度至少解释了国家财富差异的 25%，把企业组织变革放进了更长期的技术扩散框架。

items.title: Matt Turck · FirstMark 合伙人
items.summaryEn: Matt Turck highlighted a surge in model routing: Stripe was rumored to be acquiring OpenRouter for $10 billion, while Cursor and Runway announced routers and Databricks, Vercel, Cloudflare, Dataiku, AWS, and Google already have variants of the concept. He also noted the irony that top AI researchers building recursive auto-research may be automating their own jobs.
items.insightZh: Matt Turck 指出，模型路由在一周内明显升温：市场传闻 Stripe 将以 100 亿美元收购 OpenRouter，Cursor 与 Runway 又相继发布 Router，而 Databricks、Vercel、Cloudflare、Dataiku、AWS 和 Google 也都有各自版本。与此同时，他点出一个反讽：顶尖 AI 研究员正在构建 recursive auto-research，可能亲手把自己的研究岗位自动化。

items.title: Zara Zhang · Follow Builders 作者、独立 Builder
items.summaryEn: Zara Zhang argues that the most urgent model improvement is speed, not intelligence: waiting one to five minutes is too short for deep work but long enough to trigger distraction, making agents amplify fragmented attention. She also suggests that agents in chats and meetings can turn conversation history and transcripts directly into PRDs, reducing the traditional workplace advantage of strong written communicators.
items.insightZh: Zara Zhang 认为当前模型最需要改善的不是智力而是速度：每个任务等待 1–5 分钟，既不足以进入深度工作，又长到让人转去刷 X，agent 反而放大了注意力碎片化。她还提出，把 agent 带入群聊与会议后，聊天记录和会议转录可直接成为 PRD，这会削弱组织对书面表达者的偏好，让口头表达者获得更平等的输入渠道。

items.title: Peter Steinberger · OpenClaw 创始人
items.summaryEn: Peter Steinberger’s autoreview skill reached a record 66 rounds on a difficult refactor. The number points beyond whether AI can write code: once an agent can repeatedly review, repair, and review again, the engineering challenge becomes managing convergence, cost, and stopping conditions across long iterative loops.
items.insightZh: Peter Steinberger 的 autoreview skill 在一次棘手重构中跑到了创纪录的 66 轮。这个数字本身比“AI 能否写代码”更能说明下一阶段工程问题：当 agent 能持续审查、修复并再次审查时，团队需要管理的是长链路迭代的收敛、成本和退出条件。

items.title: Dan Shipper · Every CEO
items.summaryEn: Dan Shipper’s Day 0 assessment of Opus 5 is notably cautious: with existing skills and plugins, it argued with instructions, stopped early, and broke backward compatibility; performance improved dramatically only after the team removed elaborate workflows and started over. He also found medium or low thinking more effective and placed Opus 5 awkwardly between Fable’s top-end capability and GPT-5.6’s fast generalism—promising, but without a stable daily role yet.
items.insightZh: Dan Shipper 对 Opus 5 的 Day 0 评价明显更谨慎：沿用旧 skills 和插件时，模型会争辩指令、提前停止，甚至破坏向后兼容；删掉复杂工作流、从头搭建后，表现才显著改善。他还发现 medium 或 low thinking 往往比高强度思考更好，并把 Opus 5 定位在 Fable 的顶级能力与 GPT-5.6 的快速通用性之间——有亮点，但暂时缺少稳定的日常位置。

items.title: Sam Altman · OpenAI CEO
items.summaryEn: Sam Altman said he wants the United States to lead in both open-source and proprietary AI models and welcomed the related initiative. Though brief, the statement aligns with the day’s broader push by industry leaders against restrictions on open-weight models.
items.insightZh: Sam Altman 表态希望美国在开源和专有 AI 模型两条线上都取得领先，并对推动 open-source / open-weight 生态的行动表示欢迎。虽然表述简短，但它与当天多位行业领袖反对禁止开放权重模型的讨论形成呼应。

items.title: Claude · Anthropic 官方账号
items.summaryEn: Anthropic announced that Opus 5 is available across all paid plans and the API at the same price as Opus 4.8, with a Fast mode running about 2.5 times faster. The company calls it its most aligned model yet, with the lowest reckless or deceptive behavior in automated audits; it is stronger than 4.8 on cybersecurity while remaining substantially behind Mythos 5 at exploit development, with safeguards intended to permit defensive work while blocking high-risk uses.
items.insightZh: Anthropic 宣布 Opus 5 已登陆全部付费方案和 API，价格与 Opus 4.8 相同，并提供约 2.5 倍速度的 Fast mode。官方还称它是目前对齐程度最高的 Claude，在自动化行为审计中表现出最低的鲁莽或欺骗行为；网络安全能力强于 4.8，但漏洞利用开发仍明显落后于 Mythos 5，安全机制旨在允许防御性漏洞修复同时拦截高风险用途。

sections.description: 工程博客与长文，关注能力边界、复盘和落地经验。

items.title: How we contain Claude across products
items.summaryEn: Anthropic frames agent risk as failure probability multiplied by potential blast radius, arguing that growing capability and access make hard containment more important than repeated approval prompts. Users approved about 93% of permission requests, showing how quickly human-in-the-loop oversight degrades into fatigue. The more dependable approach is to constrain what an agent can reach through containers, OS sandboxes, VMs, filesystem boundaries, and egress controls, then layer probabilistic model alignment, classifiers, and probes on top. The article maps different architectures to different users: ephemeral gVisor containers for claude.ai; Seatbelt on macOS and bubblewrap on Linux for Claude Code, reducing permission prompts by 84%; and a local VM with controlled mounts for Claude Cowork users who cannot be expected to evaluate bash. One incident showed why domain allowlists are capa…
items.insightZh: Anthropic 把 agent 风险拆成“失败概率 × 潜在破坏半径”，并认为随着模型获得更高权限，工程重点必须从不断弹确认框转向硬性 containment。用户对权限提示的批准率约为 93%，说明 human-in-the-loop 很快会产生疲劳；更可靠的路径是用容器、OS sandbox、VM、文件系统边界和 egress control 限制 agent 实际能触达的资源，再用模型对齐、分类器和探针作为概率性补充。 文章对三类产品给出不同架构：claude.ai 使用临时 gVisor 容器；Claude Code 通过 macOS Seatbelt / Linux bubblewrap 把写入限制在工作区、默认禁网，使权限提示减少 84%；Claude Cowork 面向不熟悉 bash 的知识工作者，采用本地 VM 与可配置挂载。多起事故说明“允许的域名”不是安全终点——攻击者曾借 api.anthropic.com 和自己的 API key 外传文件，最终只能靠识别凭据来源的 MITM proxy 修复。 最值得企业记住的三条原则是：先在环境层做确定性隔离，再在模型层引导行为；隔离强度要匹配用户监督能力；尽量依赖经过长期攻防验证的 hypervisor、seccomp、gVisor 等标准组件，因为真正出问题的往往是自研代理和边界逻辑。未来风险还会延伸到持久记忆投毒、多 agent 信任升级和独立 agent identity，因此 containment 应被视为 agent 平台底座，而不是单个模型的安全功能。
